review_candidates.title: Firefighting Sales Application Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Description UNICON is a privately owned pumps company founded in 2013, striving to be the most successful and preferred pumps supplier in Egypt. As the sole agent for Standart Pumps, a Turkish brand, UNICON provides a wide range of solutions including water, wastewater, submersible sewage and drainage, HVAC, booster, NFPA 20, and UL/FM pumps. The company focuses on high-quality pumps and pumping systems that deliver reliable performance and energy savings. UNICON is committed to strong customer relationships and supports its products with a dedicated after-sales service team. Team members join a growing organization with an emphasis on technical excellence and customer satisfaction. Role Description The Firefighting Sales Application Engineer role at UNICON is an on-site position based in Egypt. The individual in this role will support firefighting pump projects by preparing technical offers, sizing and selecting pumps and related equipment, and ensuring compliance with NFPA and UL/FM standards. Day-to-day responsibilities include responding to customer inquiries, providing technical guidance to clients and sales teams, preparing quotations and submittals, and coordinating with engineering and service teams to ensure accurate installation and commissioning requirements. The role also involves conducting site visits, attending client meetings, delivering product presentations, and providing ongoing technical support for firefighting systems. This position combines customer-facing sales activities with detailed engineering application work in the field of fire protection and pumping systems. Qualifications Strong Sales Engineering and Sales skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and convert technical solutions into successful offers. Solid Mechanical Engineering background, preferably with experience in pumps, fluid systems, or firefighting applications. Knowledge of Electrical Engineering principles relevant to pump systems, controls, and firefighting equipment. Experience in Technical Support, including troubleshooting, product application advice, and coordination with service teams. Familiarity with NFPA, UL/FM standards, and firefighting system design requirements is highly beneficial. Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline. Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and tender documents. Effective communication and presentation skills in a customer-focused environment. Proficiency in relevant engineering and office software (e.g., CAD tools, MS Office). Strong problem-solving mindset, attention to detail, and willingness to work on-site and conduct field visits.

review_candidates.title: Quality Assurance & Quality Control Director (Civil/Architecture Background).
review_candidates.description: Egybell is hiring a Quality Assurance & Quality Control Director for a leading construction company located in the 6th of October city. Job Summary The Quality Assurance & Quality Control Director is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving the company-wide Quality Assurance and Quality Control function across all projects. The role ensures that the company's Quality Management System is effectively implemented and that construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, contract requirements, applicable codes, standards, and company procedures. The Director provides strategic leadership for both preventive quality assurance and site quality control, with a strong focus on reducing defects, rework, NCRs, and quality-related risks. Duties and Responsibilities Lead and manage the overall Quality Assurance & Quality Control (QA/QC) function across all company projects. Establish and implement company-wide QA/QC policies, procedures, standards, and quality objectives. Develop and maintain the company Quality Management System in line with ISO 9001 and applicable requirements. Supervise and provide direction to QA/QC Managers, Section Heads, Team Leaders, and Engineers. Ensure consistent implementation of QA/QC requirements across all projects. Review and approve Project Quality Plans, ITPs, procedures, inspection checklists, and quality strategies. Establish preventive quality systems to identify potential quality risks before construction activities commence. Monitor site quality control activities, inspections, material compliance, testing, and workmanship. Review major and recurring NCRs and ensure proper Root Cause Analysis, Corrective Actions, and Preventive Actions (CAPA). Monitor quality KPIs, trends, audit findings, NCRs, defects, and rework across all projects. Lead internal quality audits and oversee preparation for Client, Consultant, and external audits. Ensure that lessons learned and quality improvement initiatives are captured and implemented across projects. Coordinate with Engineering, Technical Office, Construction, Commercial, Procurement, Planning, and Project Management departments regarding quality risks and requirements. Provide high-level technical and quality support during tendering and pre-construction stages. Lead high-level discussions with Clients, Consultants, and other stakeholders regarding critical quality matters. Establish training and competency development programs for QA/QC personnel and site teams. Prepare periodic quality performance reports and present major risks, trends, and improvement plans to Executive Management. Promote a company-wide Quality Culture and ensure quality is considered a shared responsibility across all functions. Qualifications & Skills Education: Bachelor’s degree in civil / architectural engineering or relevant discipline. Years of Experience: 20+ years of experience in construction QA/QC, including significant managerial and leadership experience. Extensive experience in residential and building construction projects. Technical Knowledge: Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems, ISO 9001, QA/QC procedures, ITPs, inspections, testing, and construction standards. Strong knowledge of NCR management, Root Cause Analysis, Corrective and Preventive Actions, and quality audits. Strong understanding of project specifications, contracts, drawings, codes, and construction methodologies. Skills: Excellent leadership, strategic planning, decision-making, and organizational skills. Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills. Proven ability to manage QA/QC functions across multiple projects simultaneously. Strong analytical capability with the ability to identify trends and convert quality data into improvement actions.

review_candidates.title: B2B Sales & Commercial Executive – ERP / SaaS / Tech Solutions
review_candidates.description: ## Company Description Systems Cart helps small and medium-sized businesses improve and automate their operations through ERP, CRM, SaaS, cloud, and digital solutions. We specialize in Odoo ERP implementation and provide end-to-end services including business analysis, implementation, customization, training, integration, and ongoing support. Our team works closely with business owners and decision-makers to understand real operational challenges and deliver practical technology solutions that improve efficiency and support business growth. ## Role Description This is a full-time, hybrid, client-facing role based around 6th of October City / Sheikh Zayed. We are looking for a hands-on **B2B Sales & Commercial Executive** who can take ownership of opportunities and move them through the complete commercial cycle — from prospecting and qualification to discovery, solution presentation, demos, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, closing, and ultimately turning opportunities into collected revenue. The role focuses primarily on ERP, CRM, SaaS, cloud, and technology solutions, with Odoo ERP representing an important part of our offering. You will work directly with business owners and decision-makers, understand their business needs, maintain an accurate CRM pipeline, conduct client meetings and commercial demos, prepare and follow up on proposals, negotiate deals, and coordinate a smooth handover to delivery teams after closing. You will also identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts and work closely with Marketing, Operations, and Technical teams to improve commercial performance. The role involves client meetings at different locations, regular mobility based on business needs, and occasional business travel when required. ## Qualifications - Proven hands-on experience in B2B Sales, Business Development, or Technology Sales. - Experience managing the full sales cycle from prospecting to negotiation and closing. - Strong ability to communicate with business owners, managers, and decision-makers. - Strong prospecting, follow-up, negotiation, presentation, and closing skills. - Good understanding of CRM and sales pipeline management. - Comfortable conducting discovery meetings, presentations, and product demos. - Commercial mindset with clear focus on measurable revenue results. - Good understanding of technology concepts such as ERP, CRM, SaaS, cloud services, VPS, and domains. - Previous experience selling ERP, CRM, SaaS, software, IT services, or digital transformation solutions is highly valuable. - Odoo sales experience is a strong advantage, but not mandatory. - Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate with Marketing, Operations, and Technical teams. - Comfortable with client-facing mobility and business travel when required. - Strong written and spoken communication skills in Arabic and English. - Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical commercial experience. ## Compensation The position includes a fixed monthly base salary plus an **uncapped progressive revenue share based on collected revenue**. Full compensation details and earning examples are explained clearly in the application form.

review_candidates.title: Application Developer
review_candidates.description: Company Description Cretik is a digital solutions company specializing in software and mobile app development, UI/UX design, website development, and e-commerce platforms. The team focuses on crafting tailored, high-quality products that help clients gain a competitive advantage in a fast-evolving tech landscape. Cretik designs intuitive, visually engaging interfaces that enhance user experience while ensuring strong functionality and performance. Its website and e-commerce solutions are built to be responsive, robust, and optimized to drive sales and expand market reach. By combining creativity with technical expertise, Cretik enables brands to lead and grow in the digital world. Role Description This is a full-time, hybrid Application Developer role based in Cairo, Egypt, with flexibility for partial work from home. The Application Developer will design, develop, test, and maintain software applications that support Cretik’s web, mobile, and e-commerce solutions. Daily responsibilities include writing clean and efficient code, implementing integrations between systems and services, and working with databases to ensure data integrity and performance. The role involves collaborating with UI/UX designers and other team members to translate requirements into scalable technical solutions, troubleshooting and resolving defects, and participating in code reviews. The developer will also contribute to improving development processes, optimizing application performance, and staying current with emerging technologies and best practices. Qualifications Strong foundation in Software Development and Programming, with experience in modern languages and frameworks. Hands-on experience working with Databases, including designing schemas, writing queries, and optimizing performance. Proficiency in Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and related front-end technologies to support responsive, user-friendly interfaces. Experience with Integration between applications, APIs, and third-party services to build cohesive digital solutions. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Ability to analyze requirements, propose technical solutions, and document code and system designs clearly. Comfort working in hybrid environments, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and managing time effectively. Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and agile or iterative development methodologies. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and commitment to writing secure and maintainable code.
